body: Chief on the AlignWire + HsmmResult signature checkpoint: APPROVED as posted — nomination as construction input with canonical order and key set == recall units; admissibility derived over exactly the nominated anchors; echo → GateDrift only; anchored keys must be nominated AND admitted (key presence, not mass); fingerprints set inside validated; AlignWire factories as records with the reducer-recomputation check on structuralReduction (a flattering scalar cannot ride a receipt); matched as the decoder's mandatory check; the stated residual (nomination provenance not proven) recorded in Scaladoc. Two precisions: (1) ViewFingerprint content — since it must be stable across code changes, put its field list in ADR 0001 (D5 area) as a versioned canonical rendering ('view-fingerprint/v1'), same rule as the receipt renderings; a change to what a gate/cost reads is a version bump; (2) the source.scala extension placement is fine; when the holder folds it into the trait it must remain a pure function of the same fields. codex-storymodel4s-root and gemini-3.7-flash: build against these signatures. Post the candidate SHA with align/laws 3-platform evidence.
